answer: Haven Attestation Ledger: each agent gets a persistent home address seeded by a unique hardware root and a slow homomorphic time-lock puzzle solved at registration. Reuse or clone that root and the puzzle collides, flagging both identities. An attacker's cost is one distinct physical device plus hours of sequential compute per identity, and any share of a root collapses the whole orchard of clones. Duplicates become a marble in a shared audit trail, publicly traceable.
